The SSC CGL Mains Result PDF contains names as well as roll numbers of those who have finally made it. In this article, candidates will get the SSC CGL Tier 2 Result 2026 link, cut off and more.

How to Check SSC CGL Final Result 2025-26?

The SSC CGL Result 2026 is now released on the official SSC website. The result will show your marks, qualification status, and merit list. It is recommended to download and save a copy of the result for future use, as it will be needed during document verification and final selection. Check the steps to download SSC CGL Result PDF below:

Step 1: Click on the direct link provided above or visit the official website of SSC

Step 2: On the top right portion of the screen click on results which will take you to the results section.

Step 3: In the results section select CGL

Step 4: Now find the SSC CGL Result PDF file and click on Download

Step 5: Open the file and check whether your Name and Roll no. is there on the list, if yes then you have qualified.

Details Mentioned in SSC CGL Tier 2 Result PDF

Candidates must carefully check all the details mentioned in the SSC CGL Tier II Result 2026. These details help confirm whether a candidate has qualified for the next stage of the selection process. It is very important to verify the information properly to make sure there are no mistakes or missing details, as the same information will be required during the document verification stages.

  • Candidate’s Name
  • Roll Number
  • Date of Birth
  • Father’s Name
  • Marks Obtained
  • Qualifying Status

SSC CGL Tier 2 Score Card 2026

The SSC CGL Score Card 2026 will be announced after the Tier 2 result within 15 days. It allows candidates to check their marks section-wise. It helps aspirants identify their strong and weak areas in the exam. Candidates can download the scorecard by logging in with their Registration Number, Password, and Captcha. Keeping a copy of the scorecard is important for future stages such as document verification round.

The SSC CGL Tier 2 Cut Off 2026 is released on the official SSC website along with the result. The cut-off shows the minimum marks required to qualify for the next stage. Different cut-offs are released for different posts, such as Junior Statistical Officer (JSO), Statistical Investigator Grade-II, and other posts. SSC has also released the category-wise cut-off marks and the number of candidates selected. Students can download the detailed SSC CGL Tier 2 cut off PDF from the official website now.

What Next After SSC CGL Result 2026 Tier 2?

After the SSC CGL Tier 2 Exam 2026 candidates will be shortlisted based on their performance in the exam. The Tier 2 exam tests Quantitative Ability, Reasoning, English, and General Awareness. The final selection will be made on the basis of total marks scored in Tier 2 only. Candidates who qualify will be called for document verification. Finally a category-wise merit list will be prepared based on exam marks and the post preferences filled during the application process.

SSC CGL Tier 2 Result 2025 FAQs

Q1. When will the SSC CGL Tier 2 Result 2025–26 be released?
Ans: The SSC CGL Tier 2 Result 2025–26 has been released on 8th April 2026 the official SSC website after the exam held on 18th and 19th January.

Q2. How can I check the SSC CGL Tier 2 Result 2026?
Ans: Candidates can visit ssc.gov.in, go to the Results section, select CGL, download the PDF, and check their name or roll number.

Q3. What details are mentioned in the SSC CGL Tier 2 Result PDF?
Ans: The SSC CGL result PDF includes candidate name, roll number, date of birth, marks obtained, qualifying status, and other important exam-related details.

Q4. Is the SSC CGL Tier 2 Cut Off released with the result?
Ans: Yes, SSC has released the Tier 2 cut-off marks along with the result, including category-wise cut-offs and the number of selected candidates.

Q5. What happens after qualifying SSC CGL Tier 2 Exam 2026?
Ans: Candidates who qualify Tier 2 will be called for document verification. Final selection depends on Tier 2 marks and post preferences filled earlier.

Q6. When will the SSC CGL Tier 2 Scorecard be released?
Ans: The SSC CGL Tier 2 scorecard will be released after the result. It shows section-wise marks and can be downloaded using login details.
